name: Petrovietnam Gas Joint Stock Corporation
summary: Petrovietnam Gas Joint Stock Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the collection, transportation, processing, storage, distribution, importing, and trading of gas and gas related products in Vietnam. The company offers liquefied petroleum gas, dry gas, condensate, compressed natural gas, and liquefied natural gas; gas cylinders under PetroVietnam brand; and steel pipes products.
